KEY FINDING: every "rate-curve shape" feature (rate_std, rate_range, r24, curvatures...) is a function of ONE number, q = AMT_ANNUITY / AMT_CREDIT.
The real signal is risk as a function of q at FINE resolution (about 800-1500 distinct values = lender loan products), which tree models cannot resolve.
Leak-safe target encodings of q rounded to 3, 4 and 5 decimals (smoothed, nested out-of-fold for training rows) are given to three LightGBM models:
qf_onehot (core features, one-hot categories) | qf_allfam_oh (130 features, one-hot) | qf_mono (core features, monotone EXT_SOURCE constraint).
Held-out (5-fold) AUC: 0.76713 / 0.76678 / 0.76746; their average 0.76843 vs 0.76458 for the previous best recipe.
Final = (1 - W) * champion + W * average of the three models' ranks (W = 0.7; held-out evidence: +0.0040 over the recipe, 5/5 folds positive).
The champion CSV (default: GCI_submission_residual.csv, public 0.76815, made by GCI_solution_final.py + GCI_residual_submission.py) can be replaced by any 61,500-row champion file.
Only train.csv labels and test.csv features are used. No external data, no test labels.

first_25_lines: GCI World 2026 — Rate-Curve + Financial-Template Residual Candidate
Reproducible submission generation using ONLY competition train/test/sample files
and the protected current champion submission.
2) Add only the 12 rate-curve features that survived fresh screening:
- latent duration under fixed annual rate assumptions: 6%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 30%, 40%
- exact implied annual rate at durations 12,24,36,48,60,84,120 months
3) Train three LightGBM models on the 79-feature representation and average ranks.
4) Build a leak-safe CA=(AMT_CREDIT, AMT_ANNUITY) conditional residual prior:
template expected risk -> target residual -> template x state residual,
using EXT missingness, employment sentinel, contract/housing/income states,
and deciles of credit/income and annuity/income. Bayesian shrinkage alpha=80.
5) Start from the protected current 0.76815 champion rank. Only for the lower
93% of champion risk, apply: 85% champion + 10% rate-curve + 5% TRES.
Preserve the top 7% exactly at champion rank.
6) Verify exact sample IDs/order and write one CSV.
No external data, no test labels, no manual row edits, no pseudo-labels.

below the extreme-risk tail but hurts in the top ~6%.

3) preserves the recovered champion ranking for the top 6%.

name: solution_v5_gci_research.py
first_25_lines: """Home Credit Default Risk - v5  (solo train.csv + test.csv)  = v4 + protocolo experimental
LightGBM + XGBoost + CatBoost + modelo lineal, features nuevos, Target Encoding sin leakage y 4 tipos de mezcla.
* Features: ~15 interacciones EXT_SOURCE por pares, imputación de EXT_SOURCE (EXT_k_PRED / EXT_k_RESID), plazo e
interés implícitos, "edad a la que ocurrió cada evento", frequency encoding, riesgo relativo por grupo de pares.
* Target Encoding con K-Fold interno (calculado DENTRO de cada fold -> el OOF sigue siendo honesto).
* Más diversidad: lgbet (extra-trees), xgbd, cat2, lr; todos aceptan varias semillas.
* Blend: promedio de rangos / Nelder-Mead / hill-climbing / stacking, comparados con AUC en validación cruzada.
* Robustez: columnas opcionales (no falla si falta alguna), checkpoints con hash de configuración, features cacheados.
Novedades de v5 (TODO lo nuevo está APAGADO por defecto: solo se enciende si la validación lo acepta)
* Modo `cv:<exp>`      CV estratificada repetida (3x5) de LightGBM por configuración; exp se puede combinar con '+'
(ej. cv:A_base, cv:B_mono, cv:D_knn, cv:B_mono+D_quant). Guarda cada repetición (reanudable).
* Modo `cmp`           tabla idea | delta OOF (media +- desv) | victorias | decisión; escribe accepted.json.
* Modo `adv`           adversarial validation train vs test (+ lista de features con drift fuerte).
* Modo `leak`          detección de leakage: AUC por feature, TARGET permutado, brecha train/val de TE y KNN.
* Modo `nullimp`       null importance + permutation importance -> lista de features podables.
* Modo `optuna`        TPE sobre LightGBM (reanudable, sqlite); `lgbf:<semillas>` = config final con lr 0.01.
* Opciones de modelado (CFG): restricciones monotónicas EXT, features por cuantiles (Q_*), KNN-target dentro del
fold, poda/drift, pseudo-etiquetado estricto (modelo del propio fold, validación solo en filas reales).
* Modelos nuevos: lgbm, xgbm (monótonos), lgbgoss, lgbdart, lgblin, cat3, mlp, lgbf.
* Blend: + stacking con GBDT pequeño, CV repetida, matriz de correlación y aporte marginal por modelo.
Uso (los mismos modos que v3; las semillas se separan con comas):
